data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 野餐盒里的最后一口
data.description: 周末河堤野餐，杏菜穿蓝白棒球外套和牛仔裤坐在野餐垫上，认真把最后一块炸鸡拨到饭团旁。她合掌停了一秒，抬头望见风吹过草地，失落的嘴角慢慢扬起来。
data.action: 摆好便当最后一口，合掌后抬头看向草地。
data.promptProse: Anna Yanami sits on the weekend picnic mat, carefully moving the last fried-chicken piece beside her rice ball before pausing with hands together. Her blue-and-white baseball jacket covers a yellow T-shirt above light jeans. She looks up as wind crosses the riverbank grass, disappointment slowly easing into a smile. Gentle midday light brightens the meal and jacket sleeves in the medium view, with soft grass shadows beyond the mat.
